artDirection.summary: Hybrid commercial loading key art. Build a cinematic stylized city in 3D for perspective, lighting and depth, then deliberately repaint and finish it in 2D so the final result reads as game illustration rather than a Blender render.
artDirection.visualStory: A lively growing city at blue-hour sunset: river and bridge in the foreground, a curving boulevard pulling the eye into colorful mixed-use blocks, a civic tower, construction crane, trees, small citizens and a park district with a ferris wheel. The city may contain invented architecture and exaggerated scale.
rules: 3D is only the structural foundation; final image must receive a visible 2D art-finishing pass
do not obey gameplay camera, grid, footprints or current runtime asset inventory
avoid flat wall-of-buildings composition and avoid blockout / asset-showcase framing
use foreground, midground and skyline depth
prefer cinematic diagonals and curved perspective flow
allow invented buildings, attractions and city infrastructure
preserve upper-left breathing room for logo treatment
do not bake logo, loading text or progress bar into the illustration
